llmSettings.title: Model settings
llmSettings.subtitle: Choose which AI model this agent uses — the self-hosted model or an external provider.
llmSettings.adminOnly: Only administrators can change model settings.
llmSettings.readOnly: These settings are managed elsewhere for this agent. You can review them and test the connection here.
llmSettings.restrictedHosts: This deployment only allows these model hosts: {{hosts}}. Any other address is refused.

fields.enabledHint: Turn the model off without redeploying. The agent then answers that the model is disabled.
fields.providerHint: Use OpenAI-compatible for OpenAI, Groq, Azure's compatible route, vLLM, Ollama and similar servers. Use Anthropic for Claude.
fields.baseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the provider's public endpoint.
fields.modelHint: The exact model name. For documents with images, pick a vision-capable model.
fields.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key
fields.vllmExtrasHint: Sends a vLLM-only setting that stops Qwen3 spending its token budget on a thinking trace. Leave off for hosted providers.

test.keyHint: The connection is tested with the values above; a blank key uses the saved one.

confirm.saveMessage: New requests from every user of this agent will use this model straight away.
confirm.saveWarning: Documents and questions are sent to the provider you chose. Check that this is permitted for the data this agent handles.
confirm.resetMessage: The saved settings are removed and the agent goes back to its configured defaults.

toast.loadFailed: Could not load the model settings
toast.saveFailed: Could not save the model settings
toast.invalid: Some settings are invalid — check the highlighted fields
toast.notAuthorised: You are not allowed to change these settings
